channel.title: Net Sense
channel.description: Studio network monitoring for Mac, by Nathaniel Labs.

item.description:
# Net Sense 1.0.0
The first native release. A real Mac app — no Chrome, no Chromium, nothing to install alongside it.
- **Verdict** — grades each internet line and proves which provider is at fault, with a timestamped record you can send straight to ACT or Jio support. - **Airspace** — reads the Wi-Fi around you: who is on which channel, how crowded the air is, and where to move. - **Devices, Speed, Coverage, Power and Log** — every client, every line, the whole power path. - Finds your router by itself; asks for the controller login once and keeps it in the Mac's Keychain. - Opens on any phone or tablet on the same network for viewing.
